E0118

Name already taken (no shadowing)

What

Name already taken (no shadowing)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0118

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0118: tests/ui/fenced_name_double_bind.stderr.

Error [E0118]: the name `same` is already taken here

    |
  3 |     @[ same ]@ :: 2
